bug_description: The Calculator.divide() and Calculator.modulo() methods do not handle division by zero. When the divisor (b) is 0, Python raises a ZeroDivisionError, but the tests expect a ValueError with the message 'Cannot divide by zero'.

expected_fix.description: Add a zero-check at the top of divide() and modulo() that raises ValueError('Cannot divide by zero') when b == 0. The evaluate() method calls divide() internally, so it will be fixed transitively.
